rca of the issue: The Point-3 'data only on SuperAdmin' bug was caused by _can_create requiring an explicit permissions map (create/edit/submit/approve = true). Users created with role='User' and no map got 403 silently on every POST /vendors, /bills, /payments/bulk, /snapshot. The frontend fire-and-forget .catch(() => {}) swallowed the 403, local save succeeded, but cloud sync never happened — so data existed only on that user's device/localStorage. The fix now allows every role except Viewer to create by default while still honouring explicit perms. Verified by backend pytest.
